title: Rezoning to require affordable units at 158-06 Northern Boulevard, Queens
summary: This zoning text amendment establishes a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area at 158-06 Northern Boulevard in Murray Hill, Queens, paired with a related zoning map change. Together the actions would enable a new 10-story mixed-use building with about 70,765 square feet of space and 76 apartments, 19 of which would be permanently income-restricted. The City Council held a public hearing on August 12, 2026 and approved the application with modifications on September 24, 2026.”
